# Cut › Smash Cut

**What belongs here.** An abrupt jump in tone, volume or energy, for contrast or comedy.

**Examples.** silence → loud party

**Family test.** Step through frame by frame: does any frame mix A and B? If not, it is a Cut.

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Smash Cut with Shake](smash-cut-shake/) | A hard cut to the next scene, which lands with a short, decaying camera shake. |
| [Strobe Cut](strobe-cut/) | Cuts back and forth between the two scenes faster and faster, then lands on the new one. |
